headline: 100% time in range, steady
summary: 44-year-old female, colorectal cancer, 1.2 years after treatment; normal at start; group: tips by email; night shift. Average sugar 108 mg/dL in weeks 1-2, 100% of readings in range. Median rise after dinner 27 mg/dL. Synthetic participant (made-up data).

evidence.label: Time in range 70-180 mg/dL (weeks 1-2)
evidence.method: Share of 15-min sensor readings between 70 and 180 mg/dL.

evidence.label: Average blood sugar (weeks 1-2)
evidence.method: Mean of 15-min sensor readings.

evidence.label: Readings above 180 mg/dL (weeks 1-2)
evidence.method: Share of readings above 180 mg/dL.

evidence.label: Readings above 250 mg/dL (weeks 1-2)
evidence.method: Share of readings above 250 mg/dL.

evidence.label: Readings below 70 mg/dL (weeks 1-2)
evidence.method: Share of readings below 70 mg/dL.

evidence.label: Glucose management indicator (weeks 1-2)
evidence.method: GMI = 3.31 + 0.02392 x mean glucose; an estimate of HbA1c from sensor data.

evidence.label: Status thresholds
evidence.method: alert: time in range < 70%, or > 5% of readings above 250, or > 4% below 70 (international CGM consensus targets). watch: time in range < 90%, or > 5% above 180, or average up 10+ mg/dL since weeks 1-2.

evidence.label: Meals with a clean sugar curve
evidence.method: Meals of 10 g carbs or more, with sensor readings and no other 100+ kcal item in the next 2 hours.

evidence.label: Typical rise after a meal (median)
evidence.method: Median of peak (15-120 min) minus pre-meal reading.

evidence.label: Typical rise after dinner (median)
evidence.method: Median of peak minus pre-dinner reading.

evidence.label: Dinners with a clean sugar curve
evidence.method: Scored dinners.

evidence.label: Dinners started at 8 pm or later
evidence.method: Share of scored dinners starting at or after 20:00.

evidence.label: Meals followed by a walk
evidence.method: Scored meals with walked_after_min > 0.

evidence.label: Your sugar rise after meals with a walk vs without
evidence.method: Your meals only: regression of rise on walk, carbs and meal type; 95% CI from 300 bootstrap resamples of your meals.
evidence.caveat: You chose when to walk, so this is a pattern, not proof.

evidence.label: Best estimate for you (your data blended with the cohort)
evidence.method: Empirical-Bayes: 67.0% weight on your data, rest on the cohort estimate. People differed by about 7.8 mg/dL in this effect.

evidence.label: Program-wide: rise after meals with a walk vs without (same person)
evidence.method: Within-person regression (person fixed effects) adjusted for carbs and meal type; 95% CI from cluster bootstrap over people.
evidence.caveat: Walking was self-chosen: association, not proof.

evidence.label: Program-wide: rise after a 10-19 min walk vs no walk
evidence.method: Within-person, carbs and meal type adjusted; cluster bootstrap 95% CI.

evidence.label: Program-wide: rise after a 20-29 min walk vs no walk
evidence.method: Within-person, carbs and meal type adjusted; cluster bootstrap 95% CI.

evidence.label: Program-wide: rise after a 30+ min walk vs no walk
evidence.method: Within-person, carbs and meal type adjusted; cluster bootstrap 95% CI.

evidence.label: Program-wide: rise after dinner at 8-9 pm vs before 6 pm (same person)
evidence.method: Within-person, carbs adjusted; night-shift workers excluded; cluster bootstrap 95% CI.

evidence.label: Program-wide: rise after dinners at 8 pm or later vs earlier (same person)
evidence.method: Within-person regression adjusted for carbs; night-shift workers excluded; cluster bootstrap 95% CI.

evidence.label: Randomized: HbA1c change, coaching + overnight fast vs coaching alone
evidence.method: Difference in mean (week 12 - week 0) between randomized arms, completers; bootstrap 95% CI.
evidence.caveat: Fair comparison: groups were assigned at random.

evidence.label: Randomized: fasting glucose change, coaching + overnight fast vs coaching alone
evidence.method: Difference in mean (week 12 - week 0) between randomized arms, completers; bootstrap 95% CI.

recommendations.title: Take a short walk after meals
recommendations.text: Your sugar rose about 16.8 mg/dL less after meals when you walked. Aim for 10 to 20 minutes after your biggest meal.

recommendations.title: Keep meal times steady around your shifts
recommendations.text: You work nights, so clock-time rules about late dinners don't fit you. Keep your main meal at the same point in your waking day.
